home.title: Welcome to LoadMatch
home.content: LoadMatch connects companies that need to move cargo with carriers that have available capacity across Peru.

profiles.shipper-description: Publish load requests and manage them by status.
profiles.carrier-description: Find available loads near you that fit your vehicle.

about.title: About LoadMatch
about.content: LoadMatch is a B2B road freight platform that connects small and medium-sized companies that need to move cargo with independent carriers that have available capacity in Peru.
about.team: LoadMatch is developed by CargoLink Labs for the Open Source Applications Development course at UPC.
